explanation: The target is just the general-filter version of Mathlib's `EReal.tendsto_mul` (line 567 of the same file), which states `Tendsto (fun p : EReal × EReal ↦ p.1 * p.2) (𝓝 (a, b)) (𝓝 (a * b))` under exactly the same four side conditions h₁–h₄. Instantiating that declaration at the given `a b` and composing with `Tendsto.prodMk_nhds` (Mathlib/Topology/Constructions/SumProd.lean) applied to `hma`, `hmb` gives exactly the pointwise product statement, since the composition of `(p ↦ p.1 * p.2)` with `x ↦ (ma x, mb x)` is definitionally `x ↦ ma x * mb x`. The `EReal` specialization cannot be obtained from the generic topological-monoid lemma `Tendsto.mul` (EReal multiplication is not continuous at (0, ±∞)), and no distinct declaration in Mathlib states this general-filter form, so it is a one-line specialization of `EReal.tendsto_mul` rather than a duplicate. `EReal.tendsto_mul` is proved via `continuousAt_mul`, which does not depend on the theorem being judged, so it is independent evidence; the current proof is exactly this application.
